chunks: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The land of the Day of Resurrection is fire, except for the shade of the believer — for his charity will shade him.

key_terms.أَرْضُ الْقِيَامَةِ: The ground/land of the Day of Resurrection — the physical terrain of the afterlife assembly
key_terms.تُظِلُّ: To provide shade/shadow — used metaphorically for divine protection as well as literally here
key_terms.صَدَقَة: Sadaqa — voluntary charitable giving; here it includes all forms of charity, not just obligatory alms

ai.seo_question: What will protect a believer on the Day of Judgment according to hadith?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) describes a vivid eschatological scene: on the Day of Judgment, the very ground beneath all people will be blazing fire, with the sole exception of the area that shades a believer. This shade is provided by the believer's own charitable deeds (sadaqa) in this life, which will serve as a physical protection on that Day. The hadith uses the powerful imagery of shade against consuming fire to motivate acts of generosity, teaching that charity is not only spiritually meritorious but will have a tangible protective effect in the afterlife.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Abdullah, from his grandfather, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abdul Rahman Bin Zayd, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
The land of the Day of Judgement is Fire except what shades the Believer, for his charity would shade him’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ahmad ibn ‘Abd Allah has narrated from his grandfather from Muhammad ibn Ali from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from ‘Abd al- Rahman ibn Zayd who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
The land on the Day of Judgment is all fire except the shadow of a believing person. His charity provides him shadow.’”
